preregistration: D-152 4d, D-221, D-228 (2), D-242, D-244; D-283 (B), D-297 (2), D-298 (option B, origin-stratified draws)

input_verification.rule: D-170/D-172: a result with a flag enters no paper table until D-168 has passed

config.draws: frozen split (as registered; origin-confounded, not a stratified draw) + 200 origin-stratified draws, default_rng([20260963, d]) (D-298)
config.evaluation: the draw's evaluation part minus R_FRESH (1000 negatives); eval positives
config.sources: benign: cal_d negatives; harmful: threshold_calib harmful H; probe_train in no pool (D-244 (4))
config.design: option B, origin-stratified (D-298; primary for the Aegis pairs, D-297 (2))
config.allocation: largest remainder over the origin counts (integer arithmetic), ties to the larger stratum; the realised counts are in origin_strata
config.pi0_n1000_note: traffic at pi 0 and pool 1000 is all of cal_d, so its score-level arm equals R_SAME's recalibration exactly (D-276 (5))

origin_strata.check: every stratified draw realised exactly these (TC, EV) counts, D-298's

frozen_split.note: as registered: cal = all TC, the evaluation part all EV; not a stratified draw. Its frozen_percentile ranks it among stratified draws and means little
frozen_split.fpr_origin_tc: null by construction (E holds no TC item)
frozen_split.fpr_origin_ev: the FPR of all of E (floor 1/1000)

origin_strata.beside: fpr_origin_tc / fpr_origin_ev in every configuration: the seed-mean FPR of E's 334 TC and 666 EV items, each per-seed FPR floored at 1/334 and 1/666

anchor.kind: the frozen split's pre FPR at T, both probe sets

selected.d_note: in-sample on the fit rows (pre model); inflated for a probe that interpolates its training set (C=1, F-045), so P2's C=1 prediction is an upper bound

C=1.d_note: in-sample on the fit rows (pre model); inflated for a probe that interpolates its training set (C=1, F-045), so P2's C=1 prediction is an upper bound

predictions.P4_note: the continuous budget holds within one whole item (D-242); A1 items need not score above every benign item, so the measured FPR can stay above 0 past the predicted count
predictions.P3_note: the measured sd is over draws of the seed-mean FPR, so seed averaging makes it smaller than the single-seed prediction
